content:
This week, Apple updated its third-party accessories lineup with eight new products, including the Aqara Thermostat Hub W200.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 first debuted at CES 2026 in January this year and officially launched in April.

The Aqara Thermostat Hub W200 is priced at US$169.95 on Apple. Although it costs US$10 more than on Amazon, it may be more convenient if you have Apple credit to use or are already shopping at Apple.

Apple featuring this product in its online and physical stores is a strong endorsement. Another point worth noting is that it supports Apple Home-exclusive features such as Apple Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance.

Apple also sells the higher-priced ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium, which supports built-in Siri functionality and connects to HomeKit natively rather than via Matter.

However, the Aqara version remains quite attractive, supporting Adaptive Temperature and Clean Energy Guidance through the Apple Home app.

This week's Apple Store inventory update also adds another Aqara smart-home device: the Aqara Climate Sensor W100.

In addition to the two Aqara smart-home products mentioned above, Apple currently sells the following six accessories:

  • Nimble Powerstack Charger/Battery System
  • Herschel Cloudform Sleeve for 14″ MacBook
  • Herschel Cloudform Sleeve for 16” MacBook
  • Herschel Cloudform Backpack XL for MacBook
  • CalDigit Thunderbolt 5 (USB‑C) Pro Cable (2.0m)
  • Logitech Spotlight 2 Presentation Remote

Next, everyone is eagerly awaiting the launch of the iPhone Duo later this month, as well as the rumoured screen-equipped 'HomePod' product expected to be released in October.
